aerial: Map Data © Singapore Land Authority / OneMap OrthoJPG, zoom 20.
crownSurvey: Estimated equivalent canopy diameter, aspect along and across Connaught Drive, centre offset, and relative RGB from connected aerial foliage around each surveyed stem. Roots were checked against the rendered ground. Where crown and stem registration allowed, the horizontal transform and centre offset were refined against the rendered orthographic footprint.

foliageSurvey.reference: Relative to the 39 registered Connaught Drive crowns in the same aerial image and scene daylight.
foliageSurvey.spatialSplit: 8-pixel blocks in the zoom-20 orthophoto. Fit on three quarters and reserve one quarter for comparison.
